description: This file defines an abstract class 'CosmosOptions' that encapsulates configuration options for Azure Cosmos DB storage used within the Orleans project, along with related interfaces and default implementations for executing Cosmos DB operations.

classes.name: CosmosOptions
classes.description: Abstract class providing configuration options for Azure Cosmos DB storage within Orleans, including connection setup methods and resource management flags.

classes.name: ICosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for executing Cosmos DB operations with retry logic.

classes.name: DefaultCosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Default implementation of ICosmosOperationExecutor that handles retries on rate limiting errors.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Overloaded methods to configure the CosmosClient instance using various parameter options such as connection string, endpoint with credential, or a delegate.

methods.name: ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Executes a Cosmos DB operation with handling for rate limiting retries, part of the ICosmosOperationExecutor interface.
